question: What is the longest you have ever kept a prank going on someone?
story: For a whole year, my roommate thought our apartment was haunted, and I was the ghost. It started as an accident. I moved his keys once, and he swore he left them by the door. So I kept going. I hid one sock from every pair. I turned the TV on at three in the morning. I recorded a low whisper and played it through a speaker behind the couch. He bought sage. He bought a cross. He called his mom crying. Then one night he set up a camera to catch the ghost, and I completely forgot. The next morning he watched the footage in total silence. He turned to me, held up his phone, and just said, you are a demon. We still lived together for two more years. He never once paid late rent again.
